text_block_list.text:
The Fillies' Revue is here. Today, we'll
finally find
out if Каррен Тян has a
chance of winning the
Triple Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At 1,400 meters, it's a little longer than
the
distance she's best at, but she faces
it with
enthusiasm and cuteness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
